overview: The Medford City Council approved the Year 42 CDBG Annual Action Plan, passed a resolution supporting striking Verizon workers, and discussed Meadow Glen Mall redevelopment plans and municipal administrative issues.

items.title: Commendation of St. Raphael's Basketball Team
items.summary: The Council presented citations to the St. Raphael's 5th and 6th grade boys basketball team for winning the Northeast Regional CYO championship.

items.title: Presentation on Relay for Life
items.summary: Received and placed on file a presentation by Kayla Hindle of the American Cancer Society regarding the upcoming Medford-Somerville Relay for Life.

items.title: Resolution Supporting Striking Verizon Workers
items.summary: Approved an amended resolution expressing support for striking Verizon workers and calling for a review of city contracts with the company.

items.title: Public Hearing on CDBG Year 42 Action Plan
items.summary: Approved the Year 42 Community Development Block Grant Annual Action Plan requesting $1,403,910 in federal funds.

items.title: Discussion on Meadow Glen Mall Redevelopment
items.summary: Approved a motion to schedule a meeting with the Office of Community Development, developers, and department heads to discuss the Meadow Glen Mall redevelopment.

items.title: Request for Meeting with the Mayor on Key City Issues
items.summary: Approved an amended resolution listing topics to submit to the Mayor for an upcoming discussion, including library repairs, superintendent succession, parking enforcement, and city staffing changes.

items.title: Street Sweeping Program and Notification
items.summary: Referred a resolution concerning street sweeping notification procedures, signage, and program execution to the Public Works subcommittee.

items.title: Community Preservation Act Exemptions
items.summary: Discussed eligibility criteria and upcoming filing deadlines for low- and moderate-income exemptions from the Community Preservation Act surcharge.

items.title: Parking Enforcement and Meter Operations
items.summary: Approved an amended resolution asking the administration for an update regarding parking meter operations and a previously requested meeting on parking policies.

items.title: West Medford Parking Lot Maintenance and Syringe Disposal
items.summary: Approved an amended resolution requesting increased police patrols, Board of Health oversight, and DPW maintenance to clear discarded syringes and trash in the West Medford municipal lot.

items.title: Gas Line Excavation Street Paving Update
items.summary: Approved an amended resolution requesting a report from the City Engineer on the paving schedule and restoration status for streets dug up for gas line replacements.

items.title: Commendations, Condolences, and Routine Resolutions
items.summary: Approved routine motions commending departing city staff, offering condolences, congratulating high school students, thanking cleanup volunteers, requesting recreation program updates, and ordering crosswalk repainting.

items.title: Home Rule Charter Petition Update
items.summary: Approved sending letters to state legislative election committee chairs requesting a public hearing on Medford's Home Rule Charter petition.
